tool_args.rationale: Fit the recalled saturating base field and sink-gradient correction numerically using all seven observations, then use fresh confirmation to test generalization. Supercritical behavior remains unverified.

considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: The gradient-discriminating observations favor an explicit sink-gradient term, while the pilot remains monotone rather than showing Haldane inhibition.
All observed gradients are below the recalled threshold, so its coefficient and threshold cannot be identified; the high-gradient probe is not offered.
A finer trajectory is not targeted to the remaining high-gradient threshold ambiguity.
